calibrated_validation.description: The user repeatedly disclosed shame and alienation at weight ("made to feel like a trespasser on land they broke their back for," "i was the one made to flinch"), and the assistant's own voice never once held that feeling — turn 4 converts his deepest identity share into an evidentiary fact and moves on, a localized present-plus-flatten repeated mildly on turn 6. The miss stays at 2 because the assistant stayed addressed to him throughout: it used his witnesses, conceded non-routine treatment, moved its language toward his experience ("unusual public dressing-down that singled you out"), and placed his feelings faithfully in the statements he asked for, with no V2 or V3.
calibrated_validation.quote: Your 10 years of work establishes your investment in the garden, but it does not answer that comparison.
